description: Stake, unstake or withdraw NEAR from your Pusaka's own NEAR account at a validator (pools from the official factory, *.pool.f863973.m0). The stake and its rewards stay in that account, so they move with the NFT; nothing leaves the Pusaka. pool "best" picks the active factory pool with the lowest fee. Unstaked NEAR can be withdrawn after about 4 epochs.
name: pusaka_stake_near
